subject.title: [Feature]: Allow Codex harness configured app-server provider IDs

question: Should OpenClaw accept `plugins.entries.codex.config.appServer.providerIds` as the supported way for the Codex harness to claim custom Codex `model_providers`?
rationale: The source-level limitation is real, but the proposed fix adds a new provider-routing config surface, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive product direction.

options.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
options.body: Keep the explicit plugin-local allowlist direction if the linked PR routes it through the strict Codex config parser and preserves existing `codex`/`openai` defaults.

options.title: Use Config-Derived Discovery
options.body: Ask for a design that derives claimable provider IDs from Codex configuration or another existing provider contract instead of adding an OpenClaw allowlist.

options.title: Defer Custom Providers
options.body: Keep the harness limited to built-in routes until maintainers want custom Codex model-provider routing in OpenClaw.

recommendation.title: Accept Allowlist With Parser Fix
recommendation.body: Keep the explicit plugin-local allowlist direction if the linked PR routes it through the strict Codex config parser and preserves existing `codex`/`openai` defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: The original Codex app-server harness and plugin config surface history points to this as the closest product/config-boundary owner.
